title: Add OnBeforeFilterRemovedSourceRecords integration event in Email Impl
summary: Adds an OnBeforeFilterRemovedSourceRecords integration event with an IsHandled guard, published via the Email codeunit and raised in Email Impl's FilterRemovedSourceRecords. Partners can override the default permission-based filtering, for example to handle users with security filters on source tables.
key_points: New OnBefore event with IsHandled is raised at the start of FilterRemovedSourceRecords
Lets subscribers replace the unfiltered ReadPermission check, for example by setting SecurityFiltering to Ignored
Default filtering is unchanged when no subscriber sets IsHandled
Follows the existing event pattern in the Email codeunit's Events region
Gives partners a way to address missing attachments in Add file from source document for security-filtered users
